problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:
* Package 1: size 41 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 61 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 69 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 44 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 33 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 57 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 68 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 49 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 22: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 23: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 24: size 69 cubic feet
* Package 25: size 42 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum cargo capacity of 100 cubic feet. Load all packages using the fewest trucks. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total volume of packages in a truck cannot exceed its capacity.
